title: Heap-use-after-free in blink::TreeScopeEventContext::ensureEventPath
description_snippet:
**VULNERABILITY DETAILS**   
The following testcase requires the --js-flags=--expose-gc flag. It crashes the latest asan build of chrome as follows:  
  
=================================================================  
==3008==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free on address 0x61e000009ce0
